note: Trained from random initialisation in pure NumPy. No pretrained weights, no PyTorch, no GPU, no network. Weights are NOT in this repository: .gitignore keeps artifacts out by policy and they are referenced by digest.

corrections.field: card.limitations[3], and the same sentence in the Markdown card
corrections.was: deliberately not wired into /api/chat, because exposing a model of this size as a chat assistant would misrepresent it
corrections.now: reachable from /api/chat, where an unpinned request is refused with model_not_instruction_tuned (501): it continues text and does not answer questions, and presenting it as an assistant would misrepresent it
corrections.reason: The sentence described a behaviour the code does not have. The artifact is installed in the model library and routable, so /api/chat resolves it: an unpinned request is refused with model_not_instruction_tuned (501) and a pinned request returns a continuation labelled as one. A limitation that states the wrong behaviour is worse than none, because it gets quoted as the reason the behaviour is safe.

provenance.subject: aetheris-lite-lm (from-scratch, pure NumPy)
provenance.comparator: bigram baseline on identical held-out tokens

decoding.note: perplexity is teacher-forced; no sampling involved in the gate metric

limitations: Character-level, not subword: sequences are long for the parameter count.
Trained from scratch on 1,431,417 bytes of this repository's own text. It has no world knowledge, no instruction-following and no safety behaviour.
Output quality is low by design of the experiment: 359,136 parameters trained for 2600 steps. This proves the pipeline, not the model.
Evaluated only against bigram/uniform/unigram baselines on in-distribution held-out text; no comparison against any pretrained model was performed and none is claimed.
Not instruction-tuned and has no tokenizer beyond ASCII-and-source-code characters; it cannot be exposed as a chat assistant in this state.
0.000497 of held-out characters are outside the training vocabulary and scored as <unk>; perplexity is slightly pessimistic because of it.
trained from random initialisation; not derived from any pretrained base model
character-level base model: it predicts the next character of repository text and follows no instructions (359,136 parameters, vocabulary of 143)
output quality is low: this demonstrates the pipeline, not a usable assistant
